claim: Cold is amazing and beneficial on so many levels
There's a lot of science on exposing your body to cold and getting used to it, including incredible immune responses
Personally, the biggest thing found with cold is that it takes you to a deeper, central, more powerful place
Cold is one of the most powerful ways to "kick resistance in the nuts"
Society raised us used to being warm and comfortable, and getting uncomfortable through cold has unbelievable benefits against resistance
The encouragement: start one practice, cold showers
After cold showers came ice baths, and generally a tank top all winter, seeking the cold whenever possible
There are lots of ways to do cold exposure
Cold showers have got to be every day: twice a week just doesn't do the same thing
Stick with cold showers a little and, with absolute certainty, you'll feel really amazing benefits
How to take cold showers: the earlier in the day, the better; if you have never taken one, start by finishing on cold; otherwise straight cold, gradually building how long you stay in
For cold showers, the earlier in the day, the better
If you have never taken a cold shower at all, you can start by finishing on cold, then move to just cold
If you have taken cold showers before, go straight cold, maybe with a little warm water to wash, and practice it as much as you can
You can do cold showers a lot more than you think: it takes intentionality and a decision
Gradually build how long you stay in a cold shower
The benefits of cold showers: lower stress, alertness, immune response and, the biggest, increased willpower
Cold showers lower stress

The cold stresses your body a little in the moment and, as with lifting weights, body and mind adapt and grow stronger, a huge part being your mind's ability to stay in the moment and not be swept away or crushed by stress
Cold showers bring alertness, not just for the 30 seconds or five or 10 minutes in there but all day
For the alertness cold brings, there's really a lot of evidence now, from science and from countless people incorporating cold
Cold also stimulates deeper breaths, which alone has a lasting effect
For immune response, there are actually studies that found cold showers increase your white blood cells, essentially your body's immune system
The biggest benefit of cold showers: you literally increase your willpower, your strength against resistance in every area of life
Strictly cold showers for between two and three years now. Warm showers used to feel good temporarily, then leave a drained and tired feeling
Things that feel good temporarily but leave you worse off suck, like alcohol
Personally, and probably for a lot of people, if you really feel into it, a long, hot shower feels good, then a lot of times leaves you more drained
Starting your day in a cold shower immediately kicks resistance right in the nuts: not for comfort, but as an intentional choice, for the benefits, strength and internal power it brings
If you've never taken a cold shower, it's hard to see cold as anything but discomfort
Cold is a little discomfort, but like working out, it's temporary discomfort that leads to much more powerful things
If you're doing nothing with cold yet, you don't need ice baths or outside cold exposure: please just try a cold shower
Cold showers "seriously kick ass" and will change your life
After the shift to cold showers, there was never any going back, in years, for the difference they made in life and in the mind
The cold is absolutely your warm friend: inside, where your internal fire, power, willpower and the real you are, is fueled and supported by the cold
